Trace distorted camera pixels through a measured flat-port glass model

Source: R/brown-lens-flatport.R
aqt_flatport_rays_distorted.Rd

Composes explicit Brown perspective undistortion with the separately parameterized two-interface air-glass-water Snell model. Does not certify parameters or infer correct cross-camera fish identities.

Usage

aqt_flatport_rays_distorted(camera, lens, pixels, ...)

Arguments

camera

aqt_flatport_camera.

lens

aqt_brown_camera with exactly matching intrinsic K.

pixels

Distorted n-by-2 source pixels; unknown rows are invalid.

...

Optional inversion thresholds passed to aqt_brown_undistort_pixels.

Value

Underwater physical rays, undistortion validity and forward roundtrip pixel diagnostic, with invalid rays explicit.
